items.reason: A fragrance-free, active-free cleanser keeps skin clean without stripping it, which helps dull-looking skin.
Hyaluronic acid adds a light layer of hydration, which suits the lower moisture score and can make skin look brighter.
A light ceramide moisturizer supports the skin barrier without feeling heavy on oily-leaning skin.
A mineral SPF 50 helps protect against dullness and uneven tone from daily sun exposure.

response.routine_note: I left out the 30% AHA + 2% BHA peel because a high-strength peel with salicylic acid isn't a good fit during pregnancy, so please ask your prenatal care provider before using any exfoliating acids. Cleanse, apply the hyaluronic serum and moisturizer morning and night, and finish with SPF in the morning.
